comment: GPU pipeline registry. Loaded at startup by App::register_default_shaders(). Each entry registers a named shader in ShaderRegistry. 'roles' lists which document layers / elements this pipeline is used to draw.

pipelines.name: rect
pipelines.description: Instanced SDF rounded-rect pipeline. Used for all solid fills, borders and page backgrounds.

pipelines.name: vignette
pipelines.description: Animated color gradient (deep purple to ocean blue) with pulsing radial vignette.

pipelines.name: dof
pipelines.description: Depth-of-field bokeh: 8 animated light sources with blur radius proportional to depth offset from focal plane.

pipelines.name: edgedetect
pipelines.description: Sobel edge detection on a procedural checker+sine scene, warm yellow-orange edges on black.

pipelines.name: motion
pipelines.description: Animated UV distortion / flow field with colored concentric rings at two orientations.

pipelines.name: perlin
pipelines.description: Three-zone Perlin noise showcase: raw gnoise, colored 4-octave fbm, domain-warped fbm.

pipelines.name: perlin_motion
pipelines.description: Scrolling domain-warped fbm creating blue-green-cyan flowing liquid.

pipelines.name: stylized_water
pipelines.description: Multi-octave animated Perlin water surface with refraction UV distortion, foam lines, and sky reflection.

pipelines.name: ocean
pipelines.description: 6-octave fbm ocean with two wave directions, Fresnel effect, foam white caps, and sky gradient.

pipelines.name: flatinize
pipelines.description: fbm quantized into 5 flat color bands with smooth transitions — flat design aesthetic.

pipelines.name: cartoonize
pipelines.description: Posterized fbm base with Sobel outlines — cartoon / cel-shading look.

pipelines.name: clouds
pipelines.description: 6-octave domain-warped fbm clouds: white-cream centers, soft grey edges, sky blue background, drifting animation.

pipelines.name: universe
pipelines.description: Hash starfield with twinkle, multi-color fbm nebula across R/G/B channels, cluster regions, subtle rotation.

pipelines.name: galaxy
pipelines.description: Polar-coord spiral arms, bright core glow, dust lanes fbm, hash stars, outer halo.

pipelines.name: galaxy_modular
pipelines.description: Polar-coord spiral arms, bright core glow, dust lanes fbm, hash stars, outer halo.

pipelines.name: planet
pipelines.description: Planet disc with fbm surface (continents/ocean), polar caps, atmosphere glow, diffuse lighting, star background, slow rotation.

pipelines.name: mod_blackhole
pipelines.description: Physically-inspired black hole: Schwarzschild geodesic ray bending (80-step Euler ODE), Shakura-Sunyaev accretion disk with Doppler beaming, photon-sphere ring (r=1.5rs), gravitationally lensed star/nebula background, cinematic orbit camera, ACES tonemapping. Modules: lib/blackhole.metal + lib/camera.metal.

pipelines.name: mod_dof
pipelines.description: Thin-lens Depth of Field camera: golden-angle aperture sampling (16 samples/px), focal-distance sweep that racks focus through near/mid/far orbs, physically-correct aperture ray generation (all rays converge at focal plane). Background: per-channel fbm nebula + 2-layer star field. Module: lib/camera.metal.
